title: Storage migration service selection
scenario: Dovecote Film Archive will retire its NAS array 60 days from now, after a one-off copy of 180 TB of masters from its NFS shares into cloud object storage; once the copy finishes the array is powered off. The studio's internet link is 1 Gbps and at least 700 Mbps of it is free at every hour of the day. Separately, a rights partner drops about 500 GB of files every week and will send them only over SFTP to a hostname in Dovecote's own domain; today a server in the machine room, patched by the studio's one administrator, receives them.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
Finance funds no hardware for this project
The copy must be verified, and it must finish before the array is powered off at day 60
The rights partner cannot change its SFTP client or the address it sends to
requiredArtifact: Architecture decision record + diagram notes + cost assumptions

rubric.label: Why live lab was unsuitable documented
The 180 TB copy completes inside the 60 days at the 700 Mbps the scenario leaves free, and the record shows the days needed
The partner's weekly files arrive with no studio-run server to patch

constraint_reason: Service unavailable or not disposable in a personal same-day lab
